name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year to all land-holding farmer families, transferred in 3 equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into Aadhaar-linked bank account. Largest direct cash transfer scheme for Indian farmers.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance at subsidized premiums. Kharif crops at 2% premium, Rabi at 1.5%, horticulture at 5%. Covers natural calamities, pest/disease, post-harvest losses up to 14 days. Government pays balance premium. Voluntary since Kharif 2020. Sum insured based on district-wise Scale of Finance.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Crop loan at just 4% effective interest rate (7% minus 3% subvention for prompt repayment). Credit limit up to Rs 3 lakh per year. Includes crop production cost, post-harvest expenses, crop insurance. ATM-enabled RuPay card. No collateral needed up to Rs 1.6 lakh. 5-year validity with annual renewal.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pump Scheme)
description: Promotes solar energy in agriculture with 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state) on standalone solar pumps up to 7.5 HP. Component B: Individual solar pumps. Component C: Solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps with surplus power sale to DISCOM at Rs 3.5/unit. Zero electricity cost for 25 years.

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation)
description: Subsidy on micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler). General category: 55% subsidy. SC/ST and small/marginal farmers (<2 ha): 70% subsidy. Maximum Rs 80,000/ha for drip, Rs 30,000/ha for sprinkler. Saves 30-50% water, increases yield 20-30%. Apply through state horticulture/agriculture department.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing and health card with crop-wise nutrient recommendations every 2 years. Tests pH, EC, Organic Carbon, N, P, K, S, Zn, B, Fe, Mn, Cu. Helps optimize fertilizer use, saving Rs 2,000-5,000/ha annually. Available at KVKs, state soil testing labs, and agricultural universities.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Electronic trading portal linking 1,361+ APMC mandis across India. Enables farmers to sell produce online to traders across states for better price discovery. Average 5-15% higher price realization through competitive bidding. Electronic payment within 24-48 hours. Free registration. 120+ mandis in Maharashtra.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Subsidized/free seeds, fertilizers, equipment and demonstrations for wheat, rice, pulses, oilseeds, and nutri-cereals. Includes cluster demonstrations, seed distribution, farm mechanization support, and INM/IPM demonstrations. Apply through District Agriculture Officer.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Subsidies for horticulture development: New fruit orchards Rs 30,000-60,000/ha, protected cultivation (polyhouse 50% up to Rs 56 lakh/4000 sq.m, shade net 50%), post-harvest infrastructure (pack house, cold storage, ripening chamber). Covers fruits, vegetables, spices, flowers, medicinal plants.

name: MahaDBT Agricultural Subsidies (Maharashtra)
description: Maharashtra's single-window portal for 40+ agricultural subsidies. Covers: Farm mechanization (40-50% subsidy on tractors, implements), micro-irrigation, protected cultivation, fruit orchards, watershed development (farm pond Rs 50,000), cattle purchase (50% up to Rs 50,000), poultry/goatery units. Apply online with Aadhaar-based registration.
